backupPolicy.note: Backup is open to everyone, on-site or off-site, every day: outreach days, OR days, Clinton/Aledo days, the recurring whitelist, governed months and the weeks whitelist restrict PRIMARY only. Soft avoids (recurringAvoid) weigh low for backup and medium for primary. rules.js READS openToEveryone: false restores the pre-9/22 reading (the day rules, the dated whitelists, the Aledo week and the hardNeverWeekdays default govern both roles again); an explicit hardNeverWeekdaysRoles list and backupOptOut are honoured either way, and an absent key means open. Still counting backup until their own items land: monthly caps (item K) and max-consecutive when countBackupInConsecutive is true. Sarkar's window-week minimum bonus is a primary soft: backup inside a window is allowed but never targeted.

weights.note: Soft-penalty weights read by rules.js eligibility() and the generator score; string weights in surgeonRules (low/medium/strong/preferred) map through this table. longRunPerDay (= medium) is the penalty per day by which an any-role run exceeds the surgeon's maxConsecutiveAnyRole (9/22, Prompt 12 A). weekendContribution (= medium; 9/22, Prompt 12 L) is the term for a surgeon whose primaryContribution is "weekends" (Khan): his full Fri+Sat+Sun PRIMARY block earns it as a bonus (soft weekend-primary per day in the score; once per block in the weekend-unit choice) and any weekend BACKUP day of his costs it (soft weekend-backup per day; once per surgeon per pattern in the unit choice), so when East allows he is the weekend primary and someone else backs him up; 0 switches the term off. Holiday units are not weekend units: neither term applies on a holiday-unit day and the block bonus needs a whole Fri+Sat+Sun no unit pre-empts.

independent gates no row lifts: availableWindows (both roles, holidays included; edit the window in Setup instead - Prompt 12 W), backupOptOut (hard on every backup slot), East busy / forecast-busy, derived East weeks, caps, maxConsecutiveDays, same-day other role, holiday opt-outs
groupRules.availabilityPrecedenceNote: 9/22 evening (Faraz, Prompt 12 W) - own dates beat own patterns: a surgeon's explicit dated available / backup_only row, entered by them or by the scheduler for them (Setup availability list now, the Prompt 14 offers painter later), lifts that surgeon's weekday-pattern rules for that date and role, hardNeverWeekdays included (Khan's Tue/Thu primary, Fierce's Clinton days, Burchett's outreach days, Acton's Tuesdays). It never lifts an obligation: vacations and the trailing edge, East feed busy / forecast-busy days, derived-week locks, availableWindows (moved from the row-liftable tier to the never-lifted gates - a row outside a window does not open the day), backupOptOut, caps, consecutive limits, the other role. A manual/import lock is not a row: a lock holder on a pattern day keeps the lock and rules.js lists the rule in conflicts. availableWeeks and availableWindows are read from surgeonRules directly and are NOT written as available rows. rules.js: rdStatic applies hard-never-weekday:<wd> only when no dated row covers the role that day (the same rowAvail flag the other weekday-pattern rules read); outside-window no longer reads rowAvail.

whitelistMonths.rule: A month is governed by an explicit date list only when it appears in surgeonRules[id].explicitListMonths (completed from the seed's explicitAvailable keys, for every surgeon who has one: Burchett Oct+Nov+Dec, Acton Oct (his November list is preferences since 9/22 evening, Prompt 12 Y), Philip Oct). In a governed month the eligible set for a governed ROLE is exactly the explicit available/backup_only rows minus unavailable rows; in other months (and for a role the entry does not govern) recurring patterns + weekendsAvailable minus unavailable rows. Dates in a list that spill into a neighbouring month are additive there and do not put that month into whitelist mode.
whitelistMonths.roleScope: 9/22 (Prompt 12 I + T): rules.js reads the role scope literally. A plain 'YYYY-MM' entry governs PRIMARY only (backup is open to everyone - Burchett's Oct/Dec, Acton's Oct); an object entry { month: 'YYYY-MM', roles: [...] } governs exactly the roles it names, so { month: '2026-11', roles: ['primary', 'backup'] } restricts BOTH roles (Burchett's November list: the ER-panel author published it, so he is not placed on a November day he did not offer in either role; Acton's November object entry left with Prompt 12 Y). The importer keeps an explicit entry as written; when it completes a missing month from the explicitAvailable keys it writes the plain (primary-only) form for a plain or two-role list and { month, roles: [role] } for a one-role list - an author who wants backup governed writes the object entry in the seed. Under groupRules.backupPolicy.openToEveryone false a plain entry governs both roles again.

dayBeforeRules.note: Both day-before rules (vacation trailing edge; Philip's day-before-Aledo) apply to PRIMARY only. Matches the group's own hand schedule (Philip was backup 10/14 before his 10/15 day and backup 10/22 before Aledo Friday 10/23) and the DB trigger, which checks start_date - 1 for primary only.

locks.note: Importer: primaryLocked = locked && (primary != null || externalCover != null); backupLocked = locked && backup != null. 10/15 and the 16 open October backups stay fillable and show in diagnostics.uncovered with per-surgeon reasons; import/manual locks always beat East-derived locks (with a warning).

forecast.note: Faraz 9/21 (evening): the Davenport schedule for the next period is not out until the end of 2026. Until it is published, east-feed.js runs the Davenport generator N times over the next period with the live Davenport inputs (config blob, time off, published weeks, read the way the live East feed reads them) and derives per-day probabilities that FAK is on East call. Probability >= busyThreshold is treated as East-busy for Silvis PRIMARY (backup allowed, as on real East days); below it a soft penalty applies; such days carry a 'forecast' badge. Prompt 12 C (9/22): precedence is published > override > forecast - inside the published East coverage the forecast is never consulted (published rows win), an east_overrides busy:false clears a forecast-busy day, and refreshing the East feed deletes the east_forecast rows for weeks that are now published (count in the east.refresh audit row); the East feed card and diagnostics.eastConflicts list the Silvis days the new East data makes ineligible. runs 200 requested; the JSON (docs/east-forecast-latest.json) records the executed count as runs beside requestedRuns; scripts/east-forecast.js reads this value as its --runs default.

eastFeed.note: When the feed (published or forecast) does not cover a day, Khan is treated as clear with a low soft penalty (weights.eastUnknown) and the day is listed in diagnostics; never silently busy, never silently free without a listing.

groupRules.regressionScope: Hard-rule assertions in test/generator-regression.js apply to generator-placed slots only; locks are byte-identical (item 3) and lock collisions are reported as warnings; item 1 accepts externalCover; item 13 accepts 'uncovered with reasons'.

s1.monthlyTargetNote: 9/22 (Prompt 12 J): null = equal share. The generator gives every pool member an implied target of an equal share of the month's open primary slots and, separately, of its open backup slots (diagnostics.impliedTargets; his backup count is balanced like everyone else's). A number here would set the PRIMARY target only; { primary, backup } sets each. There is no neutral or zero term. The share divides the month's OPEN slots by the whole pool while the deviation counts whole-month days, so where a locked floor pins a member (his own locked Thanksgiving primaries, Fierce's derived week) the targets ask for fewer placements than there are open slots (impliedTargets.months[m].placeableAtTarget) and the surplus days are placed by the soft terms alone - kept on purpose 9/22 pending a decision on a water-filled share.
